RuntimeInfluenceSafeguards.HybridBlendNote: Alpha=1.0 means pure deterministic scoring at runtime. Neural scores computed only in shadow evaluation, never at runtime.

PackageOutputSafety.PackageOutputNote: Trace collection is append-only. Package output is unmodified. no mutation to selectedItems, droppedItems, or package structure.

VectorBindingSafety.VectorBindingNote: No changes to vector retrieval, embedding generation, or allowlisting. shadow-adapter traces are pre-collected, not live.

RetrievalSafety.RetrievalNote: Candidate retrieval paths unmodified. trace collection is observation-only, downstream of retrieval.

ScoringSafety.ScoringNote: All scoring functions (ScoreWorkingMemoryForAnchors, constraint scoring, legacy scoring) unmodified. Trace captures their output without altering it.

WriteSafety.Idempotency: Each operation generates a new file or new timestamp. No duplicate-append risk if operationId unique per run.
WriteSafety.DiskSafety: Standard JSONL file write. No database mutation, no in-memory mutation beyond sink buffer.

FallbackSafety.NullSinkNote: If no FileRuntimeCandidateTraceSink is configured (Enabled=false), NullRuntimeCandidateTraceSink is used. No trace is written. No runtime impact.

PrivacyContract.NoRawUserContentNote: Trace rows contain scoring metadata and identifiers only. Candidate content text, user prompts, and contextual documents are NOT included in native trace output.
PrivacyContract.NoApiKeysOrSecretsNote: No API keys, bearer tokens, connection strings, or secrets of any kind are captured in trace rows.
PrivacyContract.NoPromptTextNote: Original user prompts and model completions are NOT captured. Only candidate metadata and scoring decisions are recorded.
PrivacyContract.CandidateContentPolicyNote: Candidate content representation is limited to: content hashes, redacted summaries, or scoring metadata. Raw candidate body text is never captured in trace.
PrivacyContract.TraceOutputClosableNote: Trace collection can be disabled at any time by setting RuntimeCandidateTraceSinkAccessor.Current to NullRuntimeCandidateTraceSink. Sink is disposal-safe via IDisposable.
PrivacyContract.TraceOutputCleanableNote: Trace output files are plain JSONL on disk. They can be deleted without affecting any system state or pipeline behavior.
PrivacyContract.TraceOutputAuditableNote: Every trace row carries operationId, requestId, and recordedAt timestamp. Full audit trail for who/when/what collected.

NativeTraceCollectionEnabledNote: Trace collection is currently disabled. No native production traces are being generated. The infrastructure exists but the collection switch is off by default.
V16_2GatePreservedNote: V16.2 readiness gate remains as-is. V16.3 does not invalidate V16.2 shadow evaluation.
